items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Connish was playing trombone... And then Connish died and we got Red.

ctx.x: There was Red Clark in the band when you were there. Who? Red Clark, Joseph Clark. He played trombone. He played trombone one time.
Connish. I know Connish was playing trombone. And Connish was playing trombone. And they had another fella play trombone with Connish. But he died.
